goal: docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md records the Next.js 16 migration on main as a sign-off checklist, every line marked met, not met or not run with its evidence, including smoke coverage of critical routes, the force-dynamic fallback, proposed rollback triggers and the not-run performance spot-checks with their commands.
out_of_scope: app/, components/, layouts/, lib/, css/, data/, public/, scripts/, tests/: no site code, content, script or test changes
package.json, package-lock.json, next.config.js, contentlayer.config.ts and other configuration
docs/specs/next16-migration/blockers.md and readiness.md: the new document notes blockers.md is stale; correcting it is a follow-up
removing or re-adding force-dynamic; adding smoke coverage for /about
running Lighthouse or the Playwright smoke on the PC; committing Lighthouse output
adopting rollback thresholds: they are recorded as proposed; adoption is the developer's
acceptance: test -f docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh test

tasks.title: Write the Next.js 16 migration sign-off checklist
tasks.description: Create docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md with the structure in design.md D2: the seven headings with their exact text, and rows V1-V13 each carrying met / not met / not run (D1) and its evidence. Re-check each cited fact against the merge base with origin/main before writing it. Record the PC lint and test results in V5 and V6, and never mark V7-V9 or V11-V13 met. Verified by test -f, grep for each heading, each row id, the removal commit, /about, the Lighthouse command and the not-run status, then the lint pipeline check.
tasks.acceptance: f=docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md; test -f "$f" && grep -q '^# Next.js 16 Migration Validation' "$f" && grep -q '^## Status legend' "$f" && grep -q '^## Sign-off checklist' "$f" && grep -q '^## Smoke coverage of critical routes' "$f" && grep -q '^## force-dynamic fallback' "$f" && grep -q '^## Rollback triggers (proposed)' "$f" && grep -q '^## Performance spot-checks' "$f" && for i in $(seq 1 13); do grep -qE "^\| *V$i *\|" "$f" || exit 1; done && grep -qF '60a7a1f' "$f" && grep -qF '/about' "$f" && grep -qF 'npx -y lighthouse' "$f" && grep -qF 'not run' "$f" && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint

tasks.title: Confirm no site code, configuration or other migration doc changed
tasks.description: Compare against the merge base with origin/main and confirm no tracked change and no untracked file under the site's code, content, script, test, package and configuration paths, or in blockers.md and readiness.md. Then run the unit tests. Verified by git diff --quiet against the merge base, an empty git status --porcelain for those paths, and the test pipeline check.
tasks.acceptance: b="$(git merge-base HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main)" && git diff --quiet "$b" -- app components layouts lib css data public scripts tests package.json package-lock.json next.config.js contentlayer.config.ts docs/specs/next16-migration/blockers.md docs/specs/next16-migration/readiness.md && test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- app components layouts lib css data public scripts tests docs/specs/next16-migration/blockers.md docs/specs/next16-migration/readiness.md)" && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh test
